strings.meta.title: pdff — Haɗawa, juyawa da gyara PDF, Word, Excel kyauta
strings.meta.description: Kayan aiki na kan intanet kyauta don haɗawa, juyawa, matsewa, raba da kiyaye fayilolinku na PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint da hotuna. Ba buƙatar rajista ba, ana goge fayiloli nan take.
strings.meta.keywords: haɗa pdf, juya pdf, pdf zuwa word, word zuwa pdf, jpg zuwa pdf, pdf zuwa jpg, matse pdf, raba pdf, excel zuwa pdf, kayan aikin pdf kyauta
strings.footer.text: Kyauta, babu rajista. Ana goge fayilolinku da zaran an gama sarrafa su.
strings.home.title: Dukan takardunka, a cikin kayan aiki guda ɗaya.
strings.home.subtitle: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, hotuna: haɗawa, juyawa da gyarawa cikin daƙiƙa kaɗan.
strings.home.trust: Kyauta, babu rajista, babu alamar ruwa da aka ƙara.
strings.home.orbitHint: Rike wata alama, juya zoben, danna takardar da ke tsakiya.

strings.home.steps[0].title: Jefa
strings.home.steps[0].text: Jawo fayilolinka ciki ko zaɓe su daga wayarka.
strings.home.steps[1].title: Zaɓi
strings.home.steps[1].text: Sanya jerin abubuwa, tsarin fitarwa ko shafukan da za a riƙe.
strings.home.steps[2].title: Sauke
strings.home.steps[2].text: Sakamakon yana saukowa da kansa, a shirye don turawa.

strings.seo.why[0].title: 100% kyauta
strings.seo.why[0].text: Babu biyan kuɗi, babu katin cire kuɗi, babu alamar ruwa da aka ƙara a kan takardunku.
strings.seo.why[1].title: Babu rajista
strings.seo.why[1].text: Babu asusun da za a ƙirƙira: buɗe shafin, jefa fayilolinka, an gama.
strings.seo.why[2].title: Fayilolinka sun kasance naku ne
strings.seo.why[2].text: An sarrafa su, sannan an goge them nan take. Ba ma riƙe takardunku ko bayananku.
strings.seo.why[3].title: Kowane tsari
strings.seo.why[3].text: PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, OpenDocument, hotuna, EPUB… daga kwamfuta ko waya.
strings.seo.faqTitle: Tambayoyin da aka fi yin su akai-akai
strings.seo.faq[0].q: Shin pdff kyauta ne da gaske?
strings.seo.faq[0].a: Eh. Kowane kayan aiki kyauta ne, babu alamar ruwa kuma babu abin da aka kulle a bayan biyan kuɗi. Ba a taɓa buƙatar katin cire kuɗi ba.
strings.seo.faq[1].a: A'a. Babu rajista, babu adireshin imel: kuna amfani da kayan aikin nan take.
strings.seo.faq[2].a: A'a. Ana amfani da fayilolinka ne kawai don aikin da kuka nema, sannan a goge them. Babu wanda ke karanta su kuma ba a taɓa raba them ba.
strings.seo.faq[3].q: Shin yana aiki a kan waya?
strings.seo.faq[3].a: Eh. pdff yana aiki a cikin burauz na kowace waya, kwamfutar hannu ko kwamfuta (Android, iPhone, Windows, Mac, Linux), ba tare da wani abu da za a sanya ba.
strings.seo.faq[4].a: PDF, Word (DOCX, DOC), Excel (XLSX, XLS, CSV), PowerPoint (PPTX, PPT), OpenDocument (ODT, ODS, ODP), RTF, hotuna (JPG, PNG, WebP, AVIF, TIFF, GIF, SVG), EPUB, TXT, HTML da sauransu.
strings.seo.faq[5].a: Kuna iya sarrafa fayiloli har {files} a lokaci guda, kuma daftarin aiki da aka samar zai iya samun shafuka har {pages}.
strings.privacy.title: Sirri
strings.privacy.description: Yadda pdff ke kula da fayilolinka: babu asusu, babu takardar da aka riƙe, babu talla kuma babu siyar da bayanai.
strings.privacy.intro: An gina pdff ne ta yadda takardunku za su kasance naku. Ga abin da ke faruwa lokacin da kuka yi amfani da shi, a sarari.
strings.privacy.sections[0].title: Fayilolinka
strings.privacy.sections[0].text: Ana aika su an kulle su (HTTPS), ana sarrafa su ta atomatik, sannan ana goge them da zaran sakamakon ya shirya. Manyan fayiloli suna zuwa ta wurin ajiyar ɗan lokaci a ƙarƙashin suna mai ratsawa kuma ana goge them da zaran sarrafawa ta ƙare; tsaftacewa ta atomatik tana cire duk abin da zai iya rage a cikin sa'o'i 24 mafi yawa.
strings.privacy.sections[1].title: Babu asusu, babu bayanan sirri
strings.privacy.sections[1].text: pdff baya buƙatar rajista, babu adireshin imel kuma babu katin cire kuɗi. Ba a taɓa karanta takardunku, bincike, rabawa ko amfani da su don horar da basirar wucin gadi ba.
strings.privacy.sections[2].title: Auna masu ziyara
strings.privacy.sections[2].text: Muna ƙidaya ziyara ba tare da bayyana suna ba kuma ba tare da kukis ba (Vercel Web Analytics) don sanin waɗanne kayan aiki ne ke da amfani. Babu talla, babu bin diddigin tsakanin shafuka.
strings.privacy.sections[3].title: Kukis (Cookies)
strings.privacy.sections[3].text: Kuki guda ɗaya, na zaɓi: yana tuna harshen da kuka zaɓa.
strings.privacy.sections[4].title: Masauki (Hosting)
strings.privacy.sections[4].text: Vercel ne ke karɓba rukunin yanar gizon a sabar da ke Paris; Render ke sarrafa juyawar Word, Excel da PowerPoint a Frankfurt. Waɗannan masu ba da sabar suna sarrafa fayiloli ne kawai don lokacin juyawa.
strings.privacy.sections[5].title: Tuntuɓa
strings.privacy.sections[5].text: Tambaya ko sharhi? Tuntuɓe mu daga shafin aikin:
strings.tools.fusionner.name: Haɗa
strings.tools.fusionner.tagline: Haɗa fayiloli da yawa (PDF, Word, hotuna…) zuwa cikin PDF guda ɗaya, a jerin da kuka zaɓa.
strings.tools.fusionner.seoTitle: Haɗa fayilolin PDF akan intanet kyauta (Word, hotuna, PDF)
strings.tools.fusionner.seoDescription: Haɗa PDF, Word, Excel, PowerPoint da fayilolin hotuna zuwa PDF guda ɗaya, a jerin da kake so. Kyauta, babu rajista, babu alamar ruwa, an goge fayiloli nan take.
strings.tools.fusionner.intro: Sanya duk takardunku a cikin fayil guda ɗaya: pdff yana karɓar PDF har ma da takardun Word, takardun Excel, gabatarwa da hotuna, kuma yana haɗa them zuwa PDF mai tsabta tare da alamar shafi ɗaya a kowane fayil.
strings.tools.fusionner.options.bookmarks.label: Ƙara alamar shafi ɗaya a kowane fayil
strings.tools.convertir.name: Juya
strings.tools.convertir.tagline: Juya kowace takarda ko hoto zuwa wani tsari.
strings.tools.convertir.seoTitle: Juya PDF zuwa Word, Word zuwa PDF, JPG zuwa PDF — kyauta
strings.tools.convertir.seoDescription: Mai sauya tsari kyauta: PDF ↔ Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, EPUB da tsare-tsare sama da 40. Kan intanet, babu rajista, inganci mai yawa.
strings.tools.convertir.intro: Mai sauya tsari guda ɗaya don kowane tsari: Word zuwa PDF, PDF zuwa Word, JPG zuwa PDF, PDF zuwa JPG, Excel zuwa PDF, PowerPoint zuwa PDF, PNG zuwa JPG, EPUB zuwa PDF… Jefa fayilolinka kuma pdff yana ba da tsare-tsaren da zai yiwu kawai.

strings.tools.diviser.tagline: Raba PDF zuwa fayiloli da yawa: ta kewayon shafuka ko shafi bayan shafi.
strings.tools.diviser.seoTitle: Raba PDF akan intanet kyauta — raba shafuka
strings.tools.diviser.seoDescription: Raba PDF zuwa fayiloli da yawa: ta kewayon shafuka, shafi bayan shafi ko kowane shafuka N. Kyauta, da sauri kuma babu rajista.
strings.tools.diviser.intro: Aika kawai ɓangaren babban takardar da ke da muhimmanci: pdff yana yanke PDF ɗinka tare da kewayon da kuka zaɓa kuma yana dawo da sassan a cikin fayil na ZIP.

strings.tools.extraire.tagline: Riƙe ko cire takamaiman shafukan PDF.
strings.tools.extraire.seoTitle: Cire ko goge shafuka daga PDF — kyauta
strings.tools.extraire.seoDescription: Riƙe kawai shafukan da kuke buƙata daga PDF, ko cire waɗanda suka wuce kima. Akan intanet, kyauta, babu rajista, babu alamar ruwa.
strings.tools.extraire.intro: Wani shafi mara komai, ƙarin bayani mara amfani, kwafi mai maimaituwa? Rubuta shafukan da za a riƙe ko cire (misali 1-3, 7, 10-end) kuma sami PDF mai tsabta a cikin daƙiƙa.

strings.tools.organiser.seoDescription: Canza jerin shafukan PDF, maimaitawa ko juya duk daftarin aikin. Kyauta, akan intanet, babu rajista.
strings.tools.organiser.intro: Shafukan da aka duba ba a jerin su ba? Rubuta sabon jerin (misali 3, 1, 2, 4-end) ko juya duk daftarin aikin: pdff yana yin sauran.

strings.tools.pivoter.seoDescription: Juya duk shafukan PDF ko wasu daga cikinsu kawai, da 90°, 180° ko 270°. Kyauta, da sauri, babu rajista.
strings.tools.pivoter.intro: Duba da aka juya ko shafin shimfidawa? Juya duk daftarin aiki ko shafukan da kuka zaɓa kawai, ba tare da rasa inganci ba.

strings.tools.numeroter.intro: Yana da kyau sosai don takardar kammala karatu, takardar neman aiki ko rahoto: zaɓi matsayi, tsari da lamba ta farko, kuma pdff yana lissafin shafukanka da kyau.

strings.tools.compresser.seoDescription: Rage girman PDF don aiko da shi ta imel ko loda shi zuwa shafin yanar gizo na hukuma. Matakan matsewa uku, kyauta.
strings.tools.compresser.intro: Wata kafa ta ƙi fayilolinka saboda yana da nauyi sosai? Matse PDF ɗinka yayin da kake kiyaye rubutu mai kaifi: zaɓi maras asara, wanda aka ba da shawarar ko mai ƙarfi dangane da girman da kuke buƙata.

strings.tools.proteger.intro: Kafin aiko da takardar albashi ko takardar likita, kulle ta da kalmar sirri mai ƙarfi: ba tare da ita ba, babu wanda zai iya buɗe ta.

strings.tools.deverrouiller.intro: Kun san kalmar sirri, amma buga ta kowane lokaci abin damuwa ne? Cire ta sau ɗaya da kuma har abada. pdff ba ya taɓa wuce kalmar sirri da ba ku sani ba.
